title: Reuse an unchanged response
summary: REST API Development: Reuse an unchanged response. Describe the reply when the resource has changed.
introduction: An ETag labels a version. If-None-Match asks whether that version is still current. A 304 has no new body.
learningObjectives: Reuse an unchanged response with REST API Development
Describe the reply when the resource has changed

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Reuse an unchanged response
blocks.code:
GET /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
If-None-Match: "book-v1"

HTTP/1.1 304 Not Modified
ETag: "book-v1"

blocks.text: The supplied ETag matches the current version. The 304 tells the client its saved representation is still usable.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: The client may reuse its cached book-v1 body.

blocks.text: Describe the reply when the resource has changed.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A client needs a cached body to reuse; 304 does not contain the resource data.
